text: A big survey found office workers' blood pressure fell 11 points with salt cuts; daily walks lower it.
Coffee reportedly boosts memory, tested only on students after a sleepless night.
Three startup software teams said remote work boosted productivity, but the gain faded after six months.
A new bridge cut bus commutes by about twenty minutes, versus a year of major roadworks.
Vitamin D reportedly prevents colds, per one supplement-funded winter trial of under-fives.
A reading app helped English-learning children read better than no teaching, but gains faded by next year.
Pesticides harmed bumblebees: one season in two English counties left colonies with a quarter fewer queens.
An Icelandic trial found a four-day week on unchanged pay cut burnout, but sick days stayed the same.
